name: MCP and Plugin Admission Control
mechanism: Inventories, pins, scans and approves MCP servers, plugins and tool manifests, then monitors identity, schema and behavior drift before exposing capabilities to agents.
use_when: Tools are discovered or updated independently of application releases
Third-party MCP servers or plugins extend runtime authority
avoid_when: The application has a fixed internal tool set compiled into one release
The control plane cannot block unknown or changed manifests
expected_effects: Versioned review of the effective capability surface
failure_modes: A trusted name points to a changed server or package
